items.question: What is the maximum discount under the BIG15 promo code?
items.fact: BIG15 gives 15% off with maximum discount of 100.

items.question: Can a promo code be applied after an order has already been placed?
items.gold: No, promo codes cannot be applied retrospectively after order placement.
items.fact: Promo codes must be applied before checkout, not after order placement.
